content: Jellyfish2 lock-free invertible-hash: k-mer*invertible GF(2) matrix, low l bits=position, store 2k-l remainder bits + r reprobe bits; memory/entry=2k-l+r+1 bits (~2-5B at k21-31), table=2^l*(2k-l+r+1)/8 bytes (official manual). Quadratic reprobe i(i+1)/2. CAS on 64-bit words, near-linear to 32 threads. k<15 direct 4^k array. Exact variable-length counter (-c, multi-entry, never capped); -s full->disk dump+merge. Fast at k21 because compact bit-packed entries + k-mer-as-hash + lock-free CAS = minimal DRAM traffic, no lock contention. rustkmer DashMap ~36B/entry + shard write-lock is the gap. Match properties via partitioning, not clone CAS table.
